test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The harvest festival known for the traditional boat race called Vallam Kali is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Onam**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam** is the most significant harvest festival celebrated in the Indian state of **Kerala**, marking the start of the **Malayalam New Year**.
 
• The festival occurs in the month of **Chingam** (August–September) and commemorates the mythical homecoming of **King Mahabali**, a legendary ruler of Kerala.
 
• **Vallam Kali**, or the **Snake Boat Race**, is the hallmark event of this festival, involving massive **Chundan Vallams** (boats) that are approximately 100 to 120 feet long.
 
• The most prestigious of these races is the **Nehru Trophy Boat Race**, which takes place on the **Punnamada Lake** in **Alappuzha**.
 
• Other major attractions of Onam include the creation of **Pookalam** (floral carpets), the **Onasadya** (a grand vegetarian feast), and traditional dances like **Pulikali** (tiger dance) and **Kaikottikali**.

 **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pongal**:
 
 
• A four-day harvest festival celebrated in **Tamil Nadu** during the month of **Thai**.
 
• It is dedicated to the **Sun God (Surya)** and involves the ritual boiling of fresh rice and milk.
 
 
 
• **Bihu**:
 
 
• The set of three important non-religious festivals in **Assam**: **Rongali**, **Kongali**, and **Bhogali Bihu**.
 
• **Rongali Bihu** (Bohag Bihu) is the most famous, marking the **Assamese New Year** and the onset of spring.
 
 
 
• **Gudi Padwa**:
 
 
• Celebrated as the **New Year** by people in **Maharashtra** and **Goa**.
 
• It marks the beginning of the **Chaitra** month and is characterized by the hoisting of a **Gudi** outside houses to symbolize victory and prosperity.
